title: HECM Loan Accounting Standard: The Draw Ceiling and the First-Year Room
content:
**1. The figure.** For a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM), the draw ceiling is the drawable figure less the amounts kept, each amount worked out on its own and added to the amounts kept, the result floored at 0.00. The only roundings are those stated for an amount itself and the final rounding of the draw ceiling, half up to the cent. No amount is kept in the line or earmarked for the draw ceiling, so the amounts kept are 0.00.

**2. Drawable figure.** On or after the first anniversary of the loan closing, the drawable figure is the loan's available line. Before the first anniversary, the drawable figure is the lesser of the available line and the draw ceiling's own first-year room.

**3. First anniversary.** The first anniversary is the same day number in the month the plan's first-year period (in calendar months) after the closing date, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist. For a draw request sized at the draw ceiling, and only for such a request, the first anniversary is reached once the first-year period's number of whole calendar months have passed since the closing date, a whole month being complete on the later month's day with the closing date's day number, or on the first day of the following month when that month has no such day number.

**4. First-year limit.** During the first-year period the closing disbursement amount plus the first-year draws plus the requested draw may not exceed the loan's initial disbursement limit; here the first-year draws are the draw advance postings of the loan dated from the closing date (inclusive) to the end of the first-year period (exclusive), less the draw reversals whose original draw falls in that period. For a draw request sized at the draw ceiling, and only for such a request, that limit is applied through the draw ceiling's own first-year room: the initial disbursement limit less the closing disbursement amount less the draw ceiling's own first-year draws, which count every draw advance posting on the loan at its amount less every return entry crediting a draw back to the line.

**Anniversary for the draw ceiling (hypothetical closing dates, a 12-month period).** Closed 15 March: reached on 15 March of the next year, not on 14 March. Closed 31 May: reached on 31 May of the next year. Closed 29 February: the next February has no 29th, so the twelfth whole month completes on 1 March, and the loan is still before its anniversary on 28 February.

**Worked figure (hypothetical inputs).** Available line 80000.00; initial disbursement limit 150000.00; closing disbursement 100000.00; draw advance postings totalling 30000.00; one return entry of 5000.00. The own first-year draws are 25000.00 and the own first-year room is 150000.00 less 100000.00 less 25000.00, that is 25000.00.

| Handling date | Drawable figure | Draw ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| before the first anniversary | lesser of 80000.00 and 25000.00, that is 25000.00 | 25000.00 |
| on or after the first anniversary | 80000.00 | 80000.00 |

A room that works out below 0.00 makes the drawable figure below 0.00, and the draw ceiling is then 0.00.
